file_name: Ambrose Construct Group - Major Loss Builders - Questionnaire.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Ambrose Construct Group and Major Loss Builders are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide any additional information or comments on any barriers that might exist for general construction, repair or building companies to provide services to insurers or insurance loss adjusters.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Ambrose Construct Group and/or Major Loss Builders.
